name: Historic Monuments and Sites in Kaesong
description: Kaesong, in the south of North Korea, was the capital of the Koryo Dynasty from the 10th to 14th centuries. Twelve separate sites are scattered around the city: defensive walls and gates, palace remains, a royal tomb complex, an old observatory for watching the stars and weather, and two schools, one of them for training state officials. Together they show how Buddhist, Confucian, Taoist and geomantic ideas shaped the city's layout.
